pay.name: Wages during a work suspension

references.title: The pay of the suspended days whose kind pays (suspension_kind `pay`): DO 198-18 s.24 (OSH Standards 2020 edition, https://web.archive.org/web/2022id_/https://oshc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/OSH-Standard-2020.pdf, read 2026-10-07) — wages during a work stoppage for imminent danger caused by the employer’s violation or fault, the employer presumed at fault. A wage like the basic salary for SSS, Pag-IBIG and WTAX; PhilHealth stays on the contractual basic.

pay.name: Unpaid days of a work suspension

references.title: “No work, no pay” (DOLE Handbook 2024, https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Workers-Statutory-Monetary-Benefits-Handbook-2024-Edition.pdf, ch.2 §I: days taken off may be deducted “consistent with the principle of ‘no work, no pay.’ This is without prejudice to an agreement or company policy which provides otherwise”; Labor Code art.301 and Omnibus Rules Book VI Rule I s.12 as amended by DO 215-20: the relationship is suspended and wages follow “existing laws ... and the applicable individual or collective bargaining agreement and voluntary employer practice or policy”). A monthly salary is reduced at the daily rate (the NO_PAY_LEAVE divisor) for each scheduled workday of an unpaid suspension not worked, unless the suspension records an agreement or policy that pays it (`facts.paid_by_agreement`, customer input). A daily-paid contract is simply not paid the day.

pay.eligibility:
!(has(terms.facts.rate_basis) && terms.facts.rate_basis == "DAILY")
&&work.days.exists(
  d,
  (has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null) && d.day_type == "WORK"
  &&!d.worked
  &&d.suspended.pay == 0.0
  &&d.suspended.kind != "WORK_STOPPAGE_ORDER"
  &&!(has(d.suspended.facts.paid_by_agreement)
  &&d.suspended.facts.paid_by_agreement == true
) )
pay.quantity:
double(
  size(
    work.days.filter(
      d,
      (has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null) && d.day_type == "WORK"
      &&!d.worked
      &&d.suspended.pay == 0.0
      &&d.suspended.kind != "WORK_STOPPAGE_ORDER"
      &&!(has(d.suspended.facts.paid_by_agreement)
      &&d.suspended.facts.paid_by_agreement == true
    ) )
  )
)

references.title: Labor Code art.301; Omnibus Rules Book VI Rule I s.12 as amended by DO 215-20, https://web.archive.org/web/2021id_/https://www.dole.gov.ph/php_assets/uploads/2020/10/DO-215-20-Rule-Amending-Section-12-of-Rule-I-Rules-Implementing-Book-VI-of-the-Labor-Code-on-Suspension-of-Employment-Relationship.pdf: the employment relationship is suspended up to six months, extendable by six in a declared national emergency; no wages unless agreement or policy; not attended, not a scheduled day

name: Natural disaster, calamity or other force majeure stopping work

references.title: no work, no pay — DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.2 §I,; a suspension of operation under art.301 when it lasts; not attended, not a scheduled day
the employees absent from work: no work, no pay; any backwages are adjudicated, not payroll; not attended, not a scheduled day
a lawful lockout pays no wage — no work, no pay; an unlawful one is adjudicated; not attended, not a scheduled day

name: DOLE work stoppage order or OSH suspension for imminent danger

references.title: DO 198-18 s.24, OSH Standards 2020 edition, https://web.archive.org/web/2022id_/https://oshc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/OSH-Standard-2020.pdf: the employer at fault — presumed when the order follows an imminent danger — pays the affected workers their wages during the stoppage; attended and scheduled, the daily-paid paid the day
